name: Elara Vance
psychographics: Skeptical of corporate sustainability claims; prefers DIY and second-hand to avoid supporting fast fashion
current_solutions: Meals prepared with HelloFresh promotional codes; Clothing from thredUP and local Buy Nothing groups; Budgeting tool: Monarch Money
frustration: Signed up for a 'free trial' of a project management app on March 1st; on March 31st, the app auto-charged $15.99 to her card without sending a renewal notice, and she only noticed when her banking alert popped up at 7:30 AM
decision_style: Reads Reddit threads for user experiences before downloading any free software; strongly prefers open-source alternatives
voice: Rambling and reflective; often starts sentences with 'So, I was thinking...' and trails off into considerations of consumer ethics
